content.value: A magnetic circuit with a uniform cross-sectional area of 6 cm² consists of a steel ring with a mean magnetic length of 80 cm and an air gap of 2 mm. The magnetizing winding has 540 ampere-turns. Estimate the magnetic flux produced in the gap. The relevant points on the magnetization curve of cast steel are: B(Wb/m²): 0.12 0.14 0.16 0.18 0.20 H(AT/m): 200 230 260 290 320.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
